title: Publication and information products style guide
_comment: The IRIS capture for the worked example. FOUR files, and they are three DIFFERENT KINDS of thing that a single `uploads/` entry has never had to tell apart before. Keeping the saved-page filenames verbatim is deliberate: the .html references `./Publication and information products style guide_files/...` relative to itself, so renaming either half breaks the pairing that makes it a reproducible capture rather than a loose file.

files.path: iris-capture/Publication and information products style guide.html
files.note: The saved DSpace item page. Its first line declares `saved from url=(0063)https://iris.who.int/items/18892cf3-5a4f-42a4-923c-a93f4a594dec`, which is the provenance — not an inference from the filename.

files.path: iris-capture/Publication and information products style guide_files.zip
files.note: The page's sidecar assets. Carries `client-theme.css` (571 KB), `styles.e55b0c9926626404.css` (36 KB) and three SVG logos (`who_logo`, `who_logo_white`, `iris_logo`). These ARE the IRIS web theme; the rest of the zip is Angular bundles and is not theme material.

files.path: iris-capture/Publication and information products style guide-info.pdf
files.note: DSpace's 'Simple item page' / full record, in qualified Dublin Core. The authoritative metadata for this item and the worked example for `schemas/dublin-core.ts`.

files.path: iris-capture/Publication and information products style guide.pdf
files.note: The ITEM PAGE printed to PDF, 201 KB — NOT the publication. The publication itself is 2.68 MB and is `WPR-RDO-2020-003-eng.pdf`, listed below in this same intake since bean `yl5w` moved it here from `cat-harness/uploads/`; it is ingested as `library/wpr-rdo-2020-003-eng`. Recorded with role `none` rather than dropped: 'we looked at it and it is not what it appears to be' is a different fact from 'nobody looked'.

The PUBLICATION ITSELF — 2.68 MB, not to be confused with the 201 KB `…style guide.pdf` above, which is the item PAGE printed to PDF. The bytes `library/wpr-rdo-2020-003-eng` was derived from (its `structure.json` records this same sha256). Relocated here 2026-09-21 from `cat-harness/uploads/` (bean `yl5w`, issue #663): #477 moved `library/` into `who-iris/` and left the sources behind, so the catalogue's `localPath` claimed bytes that were one instance over. Recorded in this intake rather than only in the catalogue, because this file describes what is IN this directory.

materialization.note: One item of a catalogue whose whole is 361.55 GB. See bean folio-assistant-hpax — the three states (referenced / materialized / unknown) are declared per node, never defaulted.
